SY423
Children, Parents and Schools
0.5 Credit
This
course
offers an advanced examination of the relationships between children, parents and schools, employing sociological theories and empirical literature. Attention is paid to mitigating factors of social class, gender and race with an emphasis on the links between family life and educational organizations.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY210
(or SY204*) or
SY213
or

or
